title: Kiki / Pipeline
description: The ingester end to end: Gateway → router → Jev → agent runs → Discord. Metric catalog: docs/observability.md.

panels.title: Gateway events
panels.description: Gateway dispatches received per minute, by Discord event type (the 15 handled; else `other`). READY is a new session, RESUMED a resumed one.

panels.title: Reconnects and store errors
panels.description: Dropped Gateway connections by cause (requested: opcode 7, invalid_session: opcode 9, transport: 1006, closed: a close code), and dispatches that failed to store. Count per interval (at least 5 min).

panels.title: Gateway lag
panels.description: Discord's message timestamp → receipt, for live MESSAGE_CREATEs. p50 and p95 per interval.

panels.title: Messages ingested
panels.description: Live MESSAGE_CREATEs stored, by author (human, bot, kiki), per minute.

panels.title: Router admissions
panels.description: Stored messages the router considered, by result and skip reason (bot, other_guild, too_old, channel_not_allowed, unparseable).

panels.title: Classifications: check × outcome (selected range)
panels.description: Tagged pools by the routing check that hit (reply, mention, keyword, active_conversation, none) and the outcome (continue, new, no).

panels.title: Jev confidence
panels.description: Distribution of Jev's confidence per interval (buckets 0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 0.9, 1). JEV_MIN_CONFIDENCE defaults to 0.5.

panels.title: Jev latency
panels.description: Decide call duration p50 and p95 per interval. JEV_TIMEOUT_MS defaults to 5 s (dashed).

panels.title: Jev calls and cost
panels.description: Decide calls per interval by result (ok, error, timeout), and their cost (right axis).

panels.title: Runs finished
panels.description: Agent runs whose final status was stored, per interval: done, failed, superseded (a newer run took over), expired (older than AGENT_RUN_MAX_AGE_SECS), interrupted (cut off by a restart).

panels.title: Runs by kind (selected range)
panels.description: Runs queued and finished by the routing check that queued them. Failed includes expired and interrupted.

panels.title: Run duration (claim → finished)
panels.description: Agent run duration from claim to finished (queueing excluded), p50 and p95 overall and p95 per kind.

links.title: Slow agent runs (> 20 s) in Tempo

panels.title: Agent host requests
panels.description: POST attempts to the agent host by endpoint (jobs, images, emojis) and HTTP status (or `error`), per interval. 503s while it wakes are retried.

panels.title: Agent host retries
panels.description: Why a job was asked again: timeout, connection, http (an error status), running (the host is still on it).

panels.title: Workers and drawings
panels.description: Agent workers busy (line), and drawings finished per interval by outcome (drawn, refused, failed, expired, interrupted; bars).

panels.title: Conversations
panels.description: Open conversations (polled by the leader), and conversations started and closed (evicted, cleared) per interval.

panels.title: Messages per conversation
panels.description: Messages in a conversation, recorded when it closes: p50 and p95 per interval (buckets 1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 50).

panels.title: Messages sent and send errors
panels.description: Discord messages Kiki sent and sends that failed, by kind (reply, drawing), per interval. Sends aren't retried.

panels.title: Reactions
panels.description: Reactions Kiki chose (not the pending emoji), by result.

panels.title: REST retries
panels.description: Discord REST GET retries by reason (rate_limit, server, network).

panels.title: DB pool connections
panels.description: The ingester's sqlx pool: used and idle connections.

panels.title: Leader
panels.description: 1 while the ingester holds the leader lock (it runs the platform poller), 0 after release. No data: the ingester isn't exporting.
